nobox.final_span:
10-man draft class to date Tuesday is made up of high school players from New York: two from Long Island, two from the Bronx and two from Brooklyn.
All told, five of the 10 are lefthanded-throwing, an interesting development after the Mets used their only overall pick on Jackson Wolf, a righthanded pitcher from Oregon State.
The Mets had priority over the Syracuse Chiefs since they are a Nationals affiliate. So, the Mets and Yankees can trade draft-pick talent back and forth, depending on the effort put into developing draft picks from affiliates in Binghamton, Scranton/Wilkes-Barre, and Trenton.
